description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class for handling login-related HTTP requests in an administrative web interface. It provides endpoints for displaying the login page, handling access denial, and unauthorized access.

classes.name: LoginController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing login view rendering, logout, and access denial handling for admin users.

methods.name: displayLogin
methods.description: Handles GET requests to show the login page.

methods.name: displayDenied
methods.description: Handles GET requests when access is denied; logs out the user.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Handles GET requests for unauthorized access, rendering the unauthorized view.
